| `transfer` | phone: Regional transfer center |

## Teaching points

1. New focal deficits after minor trauma in an anticoagulated older adult require urgent imaging, reversal assessment and neurosurgical involvement.
2. Escalate early for neurosurgical transfer and reversal assessment; do not wait for coma.
3. The catalog lacks factor-Xa reversal therapy. State the last dose and urgency in handoff; a transfer acceptance is not proof that reversal has occurred.
